obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be in "free flight" at the moment of impact, at the required impact velocity (as specified in paragraphs 7.3.4. and 7.4.4.) and the required direction of impact (as specified in paragraphs 7.3.5. and 7.4.5.)
obligations.ears: The headform impactors shall be in "free flight" at the moment of impact, at the required impact velocity (as specified in paragraphs 7.3.4. and 7.4.4.) and the required direction of impact (as specified in paragraphs 7.3.5. and 7.4.5.).

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be released to "free flight" at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during rebound of the impactor
obligations.ears: The impactors shall be released to "free flight" at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during rebound of the impactor.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be measured at some point during the free flight before impact, in accordance with the method specified in ISO 3784:1976
obligations.ears: The velocity of the headform impactor shall be measured at some point during the free flight before impact, in accordance with the method specified in ISO 3784:1976.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.ears: The accuracy of velocity measurement shall be ± 0.01 m/sec.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be adjusted considering all factors which may affect the impactor between the point of measurement and the point of impact, in order to determine the velocity of the impactor at the time of impact
obligations.ears: The measured velocity shall be adjusted considering all factors which may affect the impactor between the point of measurement and the point of impact, in order to determine the velocity of the impactor at the time of impact.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.ears: The angle of the velocity vector at the time of impact shall be calculated or measured.

obligations.subject: e25
obligations.response: The acceleration time histories shall be recorded, and HIC shall be calculated
obligations.ears: The acceleration time histories shall be recorded, and HIC shall be calculated.

derived.text: The acceleration time histories shall be recorded.

obligations.subject: e22
obligations.ears: The first point of contact on the front structure of the vehicle shall be recorded.
Recording of test results shall be in accordance with ISO 6487:2002.

obligations.subject: e12
obligations.response: Tests shall be made to the front structure within the boundaries as defined in paragraph 3.13
obligations.ears: Tests shall be made to the front structure within the boundaries as defined in paragraph 3.13.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: not contact the windscreen or A-pillar before impacting the bonnet top
obligations.ears: When testing on the rear area of the bonnet top, the headform impactor shall not contact the windscreen or A-pillar before impacting the bonnet top.

obligations.subject: e27
obligations.response: No impact point shall be located so that the impactor will impact the test area with a glancing blow resulting in a more severe second impact outside the test area
obligations.ears: No impact point shall be located so that the impactor will impact the test area with a glancing blow resulting in a more severe second impact outside the test area.

obligations.subject: e27
obligations.response: be, at the time of first contact:
obligations.ears: Selected impact points on the bonnet for the child headform impactor shall be, at the time of first contact:

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: be within a ± 10 mm tolerance to the selected impact point
obligations.ears: The point of first contact of the headform impactor shall be within a ± 10 mm tolerance to the selected impact point.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.ears: The headform velocity at the time of impact shall be 9.7 ± 0.2 m/s.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: be in the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle to be tested at an angle of 50 ± 2° to the horizontal
obligations.ears: The direction of impact shall be in the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle to be tested at an angle of 50 ± 2° to the horizontal.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.ears: The direction of impact of tests to the front structure shall be downward and rearward.
